title: Ɛnne a Ɛwɔ Tete Anhwea Mu
intro: Wɔ Allah asomafoɔ a wɔdii kan no mu no, obi wɔ hɔ a ne din hyerɛn tiawa nanso nteaseɛ wɔ mu wɔ Kur’aan mu. Saa onipa yi tenaa ase kyɛe ansa na wɔresoma adiyifoɔ akɛseɛ bebree, na na wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ nokorɛ ne boasetɔ a ɛnhinhim. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ tiawa nanso wɔn agyapadeɛ no da so ara wɔ daa kyerɛwtohɔ no mu. Hena ne ɔkra anuonyam yi?
clues: Meyɛ abɔfoɔ a wɔdii kan no mu baako, a wɔabɔ me din tiawa nanso nteaseɛ wom wɔ Kur’aan mu.
Wɔnam nokware ho ahofama a enhinhim so na ɛkyerɛkyerɛɛ me suban mu.
Wokae me wo Allah nwoma no mu wo nkurafoa a na wogyina pintinn na wobo boasere no mu.
Nkyekyem ntiantiaa kakraa bi pɛ wɔ Kur’aan mu na ɛka m’asɛm.
Allah hyɛɛ me anuonyam wɔ ɔkwan soronko bi so a ɛyɛ me dea soronko, a ɛnnye nkɔmhyɛfoɔ foforɔ nkyɛ.
Wɔtetee me kɔɔ gyinabea a ɛkorɔn, anuonyam biako pɛ wɔ Kur’aan mu.

trial.label: Bere a Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ Mu
options: Allah na ɔmaa me so kɔɔ gyinabea a ɛkorɔn
Meyɛɛ adaka kɛse bi de gyee me nkurɔfo nkwa
Me nuanom na wɔtow me guu amoa bi mu
Mehweree m’ani esiane awerɛhow a midii wɔ me ba no ho nti
trial.answer: Allah na ɔmaa me so kɔɔ gyinabea a ɛkorɔn

outcome.label: Ɔsoro Nidi
options: Gyinabea a ɛkorɔn a ɛnte sɛ gyinabea foforo biara
Ahenni a anuonyam a ɛso bi nni
Ahyɛmu a wɔasɔ ano ne Allah
outcome.answer: Gyinabea a ɛkorɔn a ɛnte sɛ gyinabea foforo biara

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
